tool_args.rationale: Acquire the targeted high-gradient observations before fitting: the pilot does not identify the proposed avalanche threshold or its strength.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth siphon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot reaches s_grad = 2.44, within the uncertified gray zone, so it cannot identify a supercritical threshold or avalanche strength.
The high-gradient probe directly resolves the threshold ambiguity at lower cost.
It is irrelevant to the competing threshold mechanisms.
